transcript.summary:
Built a complete, self-contained Tetris game in a single HTML file. 
- Features include a playable game board, all seven standard Tetrominoes, rotation, movement, gravity, line clearing, and scoring.
- Visual enhancements include a dark theme, glowing title, styled UI elements, and a 3D effect on game pieces.
- No external dependencies or network calls are used.
- Fixed a JavaScript error during initial rendering and ensured proper color mapping.
